paper.title: Risk-Aware Decision Making in Restless Bandits: Theory and Algorithms for Planning and Learning

settings.out_of_scope_reason: Restless bandits where each arm is a finite-horizon non-stationary MDP with unknown transitions; episodic RL-style Bayesian regret over K episodes (Markovian arms are out of scope in v0.5).
unmapped: Each arm is an MDP with finite state space and unknown transition probabilities; rewards known and in [r_min, r_max]
Risk-aware objective: expected sum over arms of a non-decreasing Lipschitz utility of each arm's cumulative reward; history-dependent policies
Learner observes the states of all arms (not only activated ones)
Episodic: K episodes of length T, regret summed over episodes against the optimal risk-aware policy
settings.definition_quote: Given a set of $N$ arms ... where at most $M \le N$ can be activated at a time, find a sequence of history-dependent policies $\left\{{\bs \pi}_k\right\}_{k \geq 1}$ that minimizes $\REGRET(K)$.

algorithms.name: LRAP-TS (Learning Risk-Aware Policy using Thompson Sampling)
I-RAWIP-TSDE (Thompson Sampling with Dynamic Episodes for infinite-horizon risk-aware Whittle index policy)

symbols.N_arms: number of restless arms N (each an MDP)
symbols.X_max: maximum state-space size over arms, max_i |X^i|

conditions: rewards in [r_min, r_max] with r_min, r_max finite and non-negative
transition parameters of arms independent and drawn from a prior

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: The expected regret defined in \eqref{eq:reg-def} under the LRAP-TS algorithm is bounded by: \[{\REGRET}(K) \leq 12 N^2 T r_{\max}\bar{|\mathcal{X}|} \sqrt{KT (1 + \log (KT))}.\]

results.notes: Bayesian regret over K episodes against the optimal risk-aware history-dependent policy. Algorithm computes optimal policy of the sampled joint MDP, which the paper notes is intractable for large N (compute marked exponential). Setting out of scope (MDP arms).
